plan.notes: Source: University of North Florida official Osprey Map (term-by-term sample schedule) for Biology, https://www.unf.edu/catalog/ospreymaps/2025-2026/Biology-Molecular-Cell-Bio-Biotech.html, retrieved 2026-10-09. UNF describes the Osprey Map as a sample schedule (not a contract) to be used with an academic advisor; mile-marker courses should be completed before/by the end of that term. CATALOG YEAR: the map is published under UNF's 2024-2025 Osprey Maps path and the page states 'Effective Term: Fall 2024'; the byte-identical page is also served at the 2025-2026 path (UNF has not published newer maps) — recorded as catalog_year 2024-2025. Terms transcribed as Year N Fall/Spring (UNF labels them Terms 1-8; sequence assumes fall start). Summer advisory tables are suggestions only (catch-up/get-ahead options) and are not sequenced. Credit ranges printed on some rows resolved at the catalog minimum per collection standard; UNF declares Total Program Hours: 120 — sequence sums to 114 at minimum elective credits, and free-elective rows carry UNF's note 'If needed for 120 total hours'. Osprey Maps do not publish per-course enrollment prerequisites; mile markers below are progression milestones (minimum grade C). Mile markers: Term 2: Attempted Hours 16-30: BSC1010C General Biology I Minimum Grade C BSC1011C General Biology II Minimum Grade C CHM2045/2045L General Chemistry I with Lab Minimum Grade C CHM2046/2046L General Chemistry II with Lab Minimum Grade C | Term 3: Attempted Hours 31-45: BSC2012C General Biology III Minimum Grade C CHM2210 Organic Chemistry I Minimum Grade C CHM2210L Organic Chemistry I Laboratory Minimum Grade C BSC3842 Writing Skills in Biology Minimum Grade C | Term 4: Attempted Hours 46-60: CHM2211 Organic Chemistry II Minimum Grade C CHM2211L Organic Chemistry II Lab Minimum Grade C PCB3023C Molecular and Cell Biology Minimum Grade C Calculus II or Elementary Statistics Course Minimum Grade C | Term 5: Attempted Hours 61-75: All BS Biology Program Prerequisites | Term 6: Attempted Hours 76-90: PCB3063 Genetics Minimum Grade C PCB3063L Genetics Lab Minimum Grade C Civic Literacy Requirement BS Bio Core Requirements.
